description: Source code for the LocalCachePostStore class, implementing caching and cache invalidation logic for post data in Mattermost.

classes.name: LocalCachePostStore
classes.description: A struct that extends PostStore with caching capabilities for post data.

methods.name: handleClusterInvalidateLastPostTime
methods.description: Handles invalidation of last post time cache based on cluster messages.

methods.name: handleClusterInvalidateLastPosts
methods.description: Handles invalidation of last posts cache based on cluster messages.

methods.name: handleClusterInvalidatePostsUsage
methods.description: Handles invalidation of posts usage cache based on cluster messages.

methods.name: ClearCaches
methods.description: Clears all relevant caches and updates cache invalidation metrics.

methods.name: InvalidateLastPostTimeCache
methods.description: Invalidates last post time cache for a specific channel and related caches.

methods.name: GetEtag
methods.description: Generates an ETag for a channel, optionally including translation update time.

methods.name: GetPostsSince
methods.description: Retrieves posts since a specified time, utilizing cache if allowed.

methods.name: GetPosts
methods.description: Retrieves posts with caching for common limits (30, 60) if allowed.

methods.name: AnalyticsPostCount
methods.description: Returns post count for analytics, using cache when appropriate.
